caption:
That giant casino bonus headline? Don't skip the fine print. Before believing a percentage, check wagering requirements, game contribution, withdrawal restrictions, and eligibility. We explain the math using examples—not fake payout promises.

Read the guide: https://www.rawedgecasinoreviews.com/articles/casino-bonus-wagering-requirements-explained.html

Independent information only. 18+; 21+ where required. #RawEdge #BonusMath
reel_script: HOOK 0–3s: A 200% casino bonus isn't automatically what it sounds like.
EXPLAIN 3–9s: The wagering multiplier may apply to the bonus—or the entire deposit plus bonus.
PROOF 9–17s: Use a hypothetical $50 bonus times 30. That's $1,500 in qualifying play, NOT a payout prediction.
CTA 17–22s: Before you click an offer, check the terms. RawEdge has the math.
